Solo & ensemble work

Music Projects

Solo performances and ensembles for concerts, private events, and venues throughout Austin and Central Texas.

Solo Brazilian 7-String Guitar

Adam Carney performs Brazilian instrumental music on seven-string classical guitar, drawing from the rich traditions of choro, samba, and Brazilian guitar repertoire.

Combining intricate melodies, rhythmic accompaniment, and a warm acoustic sound, these solo performances are well suited to intimate listening environments, cocktail receptions, boutique hotels, private gatherings, and corporate events.

Performances can be tailored to the setting, from unobtrusive atmospheric music to a more featured listening experience.

Violet Crown Affair

Violet Crown Affair is an intimate chamber duo featuring Adam Carney on custom 14-string harp guitar and Tony Rogers on cello. Their repertoire includes original compositions and their own arrangements of classical, contemporary, and film music, with an emphasis on the unique possibilities of this unusual pairing.

Odeon

Odeon is an Austin-based trio performing Brazilian instrumental music, including choro, samba, bossa nova, and baião. Featuring Adam Carney on 7-string guitar, Max Robertson on 10-string mandolin, and Bruno Vinezof on pandeiro, the group's repertoire ranges from early Brazilian classics and lesser-known works to original compositions.

Hora Once Tango Project

Hora Once is an Austin-based tango ensemble founded by guitarist Adam Carney and vocalist Ana Barajas. Its repertoire spans the Golden Age of Argentine tango, Nuevo Tango, and original compositions. Performing in configurations ranging from intimate duos to full orchestras, Hora Once presents both concert performances and traditional dance music, frequently collaborating with professional tango dancers.

Caros Amigos

Caros Amigos performs traditional Brazilian choro, alongside original compositions and works by Brazilian masters. The ensemble features Adam Carney (7-string guitar), Julie Koidin (flute), Scotty McIntosh (saxophone), and Sergio Santos (percussion), and is frequently joined by guest musicians.

Harp Guitar Music

Adam performs on a custom 14-string harp guitar, commissioned and built to his own design. The instrument combines the qualities of a classical guitar with the extended range and resonance of additional bass strings.

His solo repertoire includes classical music, Brazilian music, jazz, and original compositions, exploring the instrument's melodic and harmonic possibilities. He performs in concert settings, private events, and other intimate venues.

Austin Choro Club

The Austin Choro Club is a community of musicians and enthusiasts dedicated to playing, studying, and sharing choro, Brazil's rich tradition of instrumental music. Co-founded and co-directed by Adam Carney, the club helps foster a growing community of Brazilian music in Austin.

At the heart of the club is its monthly roda de choro, an informal musical gathering where players come together to explore repertoire, develop their skills, and enjoy the music in a collaborative setting. Musicians and listeners are welcome.

The club also publishes a free newsletter featuring repertoire, sheet music, educational resources, and information about Brazilian music events in Austin.

About

Biography

Adam Carney is an Austin-based guitarist, composer, and bandleader performing throughout Central Texas on 7-string classical guitar and custom 14-string harp guitar. He appears as a soloist and with ensembles including Odeon, Caros Amigos, Hora Once Tango Project, and The Violet Crown Affair.

His work spans Brazilian choro, Argentine tango, classical music, jazz, and original compositions. He is co-founder and co-director of the Austin Choro Club and teaches guitar from his private studio in Austin. His performance career includes tours, guest appearances, and teaching engagements throughout the United States, including return appearances as a performer and guest instructor at the Anchorage Folk Arts Festival and performances in Branson, Missouri.

His discography spans five studio albums, including Elizabeth (2009), his solo harp guitar debut, which was featured on the Harp Guitar Music website; the award-winning Libertango (2011) with the Austin Piazzolla Quintet; and Hora Once (2016), an album of Nuevo Tango and Latin folk music. His additional recording credits include guitar performances on Jonathan Geer’s soundtracks for Owlboy B-Sides, My Shanghai, and King Oddball. His music has also appeared in films, television, video games, and international commercials, including the FX series Archer.

About the Harp Guitar

The harp guitar expands the range of a traditional guitar by incorporating additional strings that resonate independently of the fingerboard. These strings allow the performer to combine melody, harmony, and deep bass notes within a single instrument, creating a rich and unusually expansive sound.

Adam performs on two custom 14-string harp guitars of his own design, built in collaboration with master luthiers Sean Woolley of Saint-Sébastien-d’Aigrefeuille, France, and Woodley White of Naʻalehu, Hawaii.

Each instrument features a seven-string guitar neck and seven additional sub-bass strings with sharping levers, each with its own unique tuning system. All of Adam's harp guitar repertoire consists of original compositions or arrangements written specifically for these instruments.

Guitar Lessons

Private guitar instruction from Adam Carney's home studio in Austin.

Lessons are tailored to each student's interests, experience, and musical goals, with an emphasis on developing strong technique, musicianship, and a deeper understanding of music.

Instruction can include classical guitar, Brazilian guitar styles, music reading, repertoire, harmony, and practical musicianship.

Whether you're developing your fundamentals or looking to expand your musical abilities, lessons are designed around your individual needs.
